card.name: Words right before "government"
card.fires_on: The word just before an expected "government", such as "federal", "own", "state" or "the", in political or civic text about authority and the constitution.

modes.description: An adjective like federal or state that sits right before the word government.

card.writes: It suppresses the word government and its variants in other languages, so it lowers the chance that the next word is government.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "government" and pushes the model away from predicting that word next.
